event.description: Test a block-1 pre-FF bias scalar independently
event.proposal: Family: scalar pruning. Current retained frontier is 2,122 parameters at 99.060000%, a +0.060000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 8 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0044 at 2,122 parameters and 99.06%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0046, where independently zeroing blocks.1.ln1 coordinate 13 scored 98.99%, one case below qualification. Hypothesis: blocks.1.ln2 coordinate 11 at -0.012189634 may be less functionally leveraged because it affects the pre-feed-forward rather than pre-attention normalization; zeroing it alongside only the six accepted coordinates yields 2,121 parameters. This is more informative than the nearest untested larger scalar because it is the next magnitude candidate and changes normalization site after two pre-attention failures.
